# JSON → classes

Generate Go structs or C# records/classes from a JSON sample.

Category: Converters · ID: `json-class` · Search terms: struct, class, record, dto, model, csharp, golang, quicktype

## Command line

```bash
devtooltui json-class [file|-] [flags]
```

## Inputs

1. JSON

## Options

| Flag | Values | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `--lang` | `go`, `csharp` | `go` | Language. |
| `--name` | text | `Root` | Root type. |
| `--csharp` | `record`, `class` | `record` | C# kind. record (init-only) or class (get/set) |
| `--omitempty` | on/off | `true` | omitempty. Go: add omitempty to optional fields |

## Examples

From the tests (`testdata/json-class`), so they are what the tool prints.

### order-csharp-class

Input:

```text
{
  "order_id": 1024,
  "customer": {"id": "c-7", "full-name": "Ana Pérez", "email": null},
  "total": 59.9,
  "paid": true,
  "tags": ["express", "gift"],
  "items": [
    {"sku": "A-1", "qty": 2, "price": 10},
    {"sku": "B-2", "qty": 1, "price": 39.9, "note": "wrap it"}
  ],
  "shipping_url": "https://example.com/t/1024",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

Output:

```text
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Text.Json.Serialization;

public class Root
{
    [JsonPropertyName("order_id")]
    public long OrderId { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("customer")]
    public Customer Customer { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("total")]
    public double Total { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("paid")]
    public bool Paid { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("tags")]
    public List<string> Tags { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("items")]
    public List<Item> Items { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("shipping_url")]
    public string ShippingUrl { get; set; }

    [JsonPropertyName("metadata")]
    public Dictionary<string, object> Metadata { get; set; }
}

… (26 more lines)
```

### order-go

Input:

```text
{
  "order_id": 1024,
  "customer": {"id": "c-7", "full-name": "Ana Pérez", "email": null},
  "total": 59.9,
  "paid": true,
  "tags": ["express", "gift"],
  "items": [
    {"sku": "A-1", "qty": 2, "price": 10},
    {"sku": "B-2", "qty": 1, "price": 39.9, "note": "wrap it"}
  ],
  "shipping_url": "https://example.com/t/1024",
  "metadata": {}
}
```

Output:

```text
type Order struct {
	OrderID     int64          `json:"order_id"`
	Customer    Customer       `json:"customer"`
	Total       float64        `json:"total"`
	Paid        bool           `json:"paid"`
	Tags        []string       `json:"tags"`
	Items       []Item         `json:"items"`
	ShippingURL string         `json:"shipping_url"`
	Metadata    map[string]any `json:"metadata"`
}

type Customer struct {
	ID       string `json:"id"`
	FullName string `json:"full-name"`
	Email    any    `json:"email,omitempty"`
}

type Item struct {
	Sku   string  `json:"sku"`
	Qty   int64   `json:"qty"`
	Price float64 `json:"price"`
	Note  *string `json:"note,omitempty"`
}
```
